description: This donut chart, presented in the context of defending against social engineering attacks in the age of LLMs, visually compares two categories—“Ambiguity” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner)” — each broken down into three response types: “Deceived” (red), “Partially” (yellow), and “Not Deceived” (green). The outer ring, labeled “Ambiguity,” shows the largest segment as “Deceived” at 67.6%, followed by “Partially” at 57.9%, and “Not Deceived” at 10.5%. The inner ring, labeled “Ambiguity 2 (Inner),” shows “Deceived” at 31.6%, “Partially” at 23.5%, and “Not Deceived” at 8.8%. Each segment is color-coded and labeled with its percentage, and the chart includes two legends—one for each ring—mapping the colors to their respective categories. The segments are arranged in descending order of size within each ring, with the largest segment at the top left and the smallest at the bottom right.
